# FoldGPT native ordinary UID checkpoint v14

This delta preserves APK r21 (SHA256 cdfbe23c7ce9e89d499bf4fcbfdf97a9380ab4b7d1faa95db78b52aa8149e4a0), ordinary UID production stage/admission/package versions 1 and 2, direct runner NDK v7, local ordinary UID evidence and GitHub CI runs 34202735339, 34203215153 and 34203936964. Versions 1 and the first two CI runs are historical evidence; they are not represented as the final successful candidate.

CI3 at source f87566908e7245550ebc59783b0d85f80264b437 succeeded with 25 recorded commands exiting 0 and 190 unittest cases. The r21 package enables managed and ordinary UID model profiles and its staged inventory and provenance are verified against the APK. NDK v7 contains actual Android ARM64 binaries and independent identical recompilations; these binaries were not executed on Android in this checkpoint. The direct worker is a validation helper; only the direct runner is shipped in r21.

The new ordinary UID path has not yet passed a real Fold UI project run. This archive does not claim Android end-to-end completion, a phone reboot/reconnect validation, or immunity to future official application updates. No phone action, root, flash, bootloader change, VM, security-setting change or official application modification is performed by the archive workflow.

The explicitly supplied final source commit is archived with git archive and bound to packaged Python, compiled direct C and compiled admission C hashes. Every copied delta file is hashed before and after copying. Main recovery plus supplements 1 through 13 remain required; their existing local manifests, v13 restoration metadata and remote part metadata are verified, without redownloading their full encrypted archives. Only v14 encrypted age parts and its manifest may be uploaded to the existing private release. The existing NexusSecure identity is opened only by age during authenticated restoration and is never copied into the project or archive.

Six inherited packaged Python sources retain CRLF or mixed line endings while Git stores LF. Their distinct raw Git and artifact hashes are preserved and their complete bytes must match after only CRLF-to-LF normalization; no other source difference is accepted. Empty __init__.py markers generated by the canonical package script are identified explicitly and checked as empty/absent from Git, rather than claimed to be committed source files.
